title: Vesper and the Gravity
author: Gideon Hartwell
blurb: Emrys Delacroix, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
